what: The real MLVApp (MainWindow) profile-settle run of PR #222 round 2 on the two tracked daylight fixtures, sync and async, recorded for the hosted CI gate (tools/profiling/test_check_look_assist_profile_states.py).
subject_note: The executable was built from this commit (tracked tree clean; untracked scratch files made the stamp's dirty flag 1). The evidence commit that adds this folder differs from it only in files under tests/fixtures/look_assist_profile_runs/.

commands.build: pwsh tools\gen-buildinfo.ps1 -SrcRoot <worktree> -OutHeader <worktree>\platform\build\build_buildinfo.h ; touch platform\qt\MainWindow.cpp platform\qt\CrashForensics.cpp ; mingw32-make -f Makefile.Release -j2 (in platform\build) ; python tools\profiling\verify_exe_stamp.py platform\build\release\MLVApp.exe --sha <subject>
commands.profile_run: MLVApp.exe --profile-playback --input <worktree>\tests\fixtures\clips\<clip>.mlv --frames 4 --exercise-look-assist-settle --output <dir>\profile.json  (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen; async arms set MLVAPP_LOOK_ASSIST_ASYNC=1; no Play action, no loop)
commands.picture_dump_env: MLVAPP_LOOK_ASSIST_PICTURE_DUMP=<dir>\pic (the analysis-thumbnail render at the applied look: pic\look-assist-final-frame0.png)
commands.master_look: MLVAPP_LOOK_ASSIST_PICTURE_DUMP_STATES=master:174,14,46,32,-26,3,6480,-19 (label:exp,contrast,pivot,shadows,highlights,vibrance,temp,tint -- the result the master build logged for these states; pic\state-master.png is that look rendered by this build in the same state)
commands.downscale: Pillow Image.resize((w // 6, h // 6), Image.BOX) of each picture (area average: the deck-region mean is preserved; deck_chroma_source vs deck_chroma_recorded below)
